rewards_check_3.name: rewards_check_3
rewards_check_3.value: ("rewards"."kind" = 'accrual' AND "rewards"."amount_cents" >= 0 AND "rewards"."refund_id" IS NULL) OR ("rewards"."kind" = 'refund_reversal' AND "rewards"."amount_cents" <= 0 AND "rewards"."refund_id" IS NOT NULL)

services_check_1.name: services_check_1
services_check_1.value: ("services"."type" = '总部客服' AND "services"."region_id" IS NULL) OR ("services"."type" = '区域客服' AND "services"."region_id" IS NOT NULL)
